triggerReasons.message: Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: Running the compiled host-run-usage smoke shows: (1) the pinned exact B-3928 turn.failed fixture produces an unavailable final with unavailableReason turn_failed(...) carrying the Codex-upgrade message digest, (2) a stream with neither turn.completed nor failure events still records no_turn_completed_usage_event, and (3) a stream with genuine turn.completed usage still records the provider-reported final unchanged.
acceptanceBindings.note: Single acceptance claim from the original intent snapshot (requestHash sha256:af05aa798076f6250ce01c745e7f232e99a069bb4f496469a9e030fcc2631476); refs enumerate every happy/edge/adversarial intent entry of the three bound items.

note: One-claim contract: the compiled host-run usage smoke is the acceptance oracle; red state = the turn_failed(...) reason is absent on baseline for the pinned B-3928 fixture.
